in_marathi.name: Manasvi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intellect, Mind, Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manasvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manasvi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘manas’ which means mind or intellect. This name is believed to represent one’s intellect and desire. In Hindu mythology, Manasvi is the name of a celestial nymph, or Apsara, who is known for her beauty and intelligence.
